# Ayush Deshmukh — Design Engineer

> Design Engineer crafting polished interfaces, micro-interactions, and digital experiences. Co-Founder & CTO of Cloff Studio. Building Scrunity AI.

Ayush Deshmukh is a Design Engineer focused on creating aesthetically pleasing digital experiences. He builds handcrafted UI components with attention to micro-interactions, motion design, and visual polish. He works with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Framer Motion, and Figma.

## Pages

- [Home](https://everywhereayush.in): Portfolio homepage with bio, work experience, and social links
- [Craft](https://everywhereayush.in/craft): Handcrafted UI components — Spotify-style filter pills, mini toolbars, blocks interaction, calendar widgets, expandable pills, hold-to-confirm buttons, human verification, and fan cards
- [UI Design](https://everywhereayush.in/ui): Figma design concepts — bento grids, waitlist pages, landing pages, pricing sections, contact pages, project showcases, settings pages
- [Writing](https://everywhereayush.in/writing): Technical blog posts on design engineering and frontend development
- [Playground](https://everywhereayush.in/playground): Experimental UI components and prototypes

## Blog Posts

- [The Rise of Design Engineering](https://everywhereayush.in/writing/the-rise-of-design-engineering): What design engineering is, why it's becoming popular, and how it helps teams create better products. Published March 9, 2026.
- [Everything You Think You Know About next/image Is Wrong!](https://everywhereayush.in/writing/everything-you-know-about-next-image-is-wrong): A deep dive into how Next.js Image component actually works — debunking common misconceptions about optimization and performance. Published November 13, 2025.
- [Micro-Interactions](https://everywhereayush.in/writing/micro-interactions): Exploring the art of micro-interactions in UI design — subtle animations that make products feel alive. Published November 8, 2025.
